There’s often confusion about what supplements can realistically achieve. While no capsule or powder can lift sagging skin or reverse age-related collagen loss, the right supplements do play a valuable supporting role in overall skin health.

Marine collagen helps improve skin elasticity and hydration over time.
Plant-based protein supplies essential amino acids that support skin repair, hair strength, and muscle health.
Omega fatty acids reinforce the skin barrier, reduce inflammation, and improve skin resilience.

Where supplements truly shine is in improving skin quality—smoother texture, better healing, enhanced glow, and stronger results when paired with in-clinic treatments.

However, lifting, tightening, and contouring require evidence-based dermatological procedures such as lasers, radiofrequency, HIFU, and injectables.

Think of supplements as the foundation—not the shortcut. Healthy skin is nurtured from within, while sculpted, firm skin is achieved with the right medical expertise.
